component.name: OpenCode
component.summary: Connect to a remote opencode server and drive coding sessions

description.p: OpenCode is a client for an opencode server. Point it at a server you run — on this machine, on a workstation over SSH, or anywhere you can reach over HTTP — and it gives you the sessions, chat transcript, file browser, diff review and terminal for that workspace.
The Linux build is experimental. Sessions, chat, files, review and the terminal work; Android-only features (Termux hosting, code-push patching, background-live notifications) are inert on desktop.
